aggregation: Eq 2-6: normalize Phi * Shannon_entropy_balance * global_minority_count_share; training records only

data.version: Pinned FedCPDP 30 CSV release, not claimed latest project versions
data.source_split: Each source client independently: first feasible five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, random_state=20261110; ~80/20; exact same row indices as frozen FLR 20261111; all model seeds share splits
data.target: all original rows; labels final evaluation only
data.normalization: source train minmax; validation same scale; target own unlabeled minmax
data.split_reference: split_reference/*_splits.json; copied from completed FLR homogeneous run 20261111; verified by regeneration
data.clients: one source project per client; same-family leave-one-project-out; one pinned CSV version per project
data.project_isolation_basis: FLR PDF p5 / FedDP PDF p11: exclude all versions of held-out target project; our snapshot contains one version per project

evaluation.calibration: sigmoid logistic calibration on pooled source validation margins, C1; same validation used for threshold selection; added evaluation adapter, not original ALMITY
evaluation.threshold: source macro MCC then macro Recall then lower threshold, .05 to .95 step .025
evaluation.native: raw SVM margin >=0 also reported; raw-margin AUC retained
evaluation.effort: calibrated probability/raw LOC; fractional-budget interpolation; no valid LOC -> N/A

evidence.unverified: Original SVM kernel, optimizer, complete training hyperparameters

limitations: All chosen training hyperparameters are study settings, not paper defaults
Cross-project LOPO differs from ALMITY within-client 80/10/10
One pinned CSV per project differs from original FLR/FedDP use of multiple source versions
Source held-out validation and local duplicate grouping/exclusion are study choices, not claimed FLR/FedDP paper defaults
